summary: I struggle to hold G7 and drop a pinkie to G just off key or screech of a scratching fret regrets in rebounding sounds you know what’s right but holding on to truth always so hard. #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
I struggle
to hold
G7
and drop a
pinkie
to
G

just off
key

or screech
 of a scratching
fret

regrets in  
  rebounding
sounds

  you know
what’s
right
but holding
on to truth
always so hard.

#smallpoems
